summary: Completed frontend testing of Property Lookup page data source selector feature. All requested features are working correctly. The JSX syntax error fix was successful - page renders without blank page error. Both 'County Records' and 'Property Leads' data source views work as expected.
passed_tests: Property Lookup page renders without blank page error
Data Source selector shows two options: 'County Records' and 'Property Leads'
County Records is selected by default with amber highlight
Clicking 'County Records' shows county search form with address input and county dropdown
Address input has data-testid='address-input'
Search button has data-testid='search-btn'
County dropdown shows All Counties, Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco options
Recent Searches section displays in County Records view with clickable previous searches
Clicking 'Property Leads' shows imported leads list with search functionality
Property Leads view shows 'Imported Property Leads' header
Import Leads button visible in Property Leads view
Search input has data-testid='leads-search-input'
Search filters leads by address, city, owner name, or zip
Property leads can be clicked to show lead details in the right panel
Lead Details panel shows address, county, estimated value, beds, baths, sqft
View Full Details button visible in lead details panel
Open Full Details button visible at bottom of lead details panel
View Full Details button navigates to the lead detail page (/property-leads/{id})
Lead detail page shows Overview, Marketing, Notes, Activity tabs
Switching between County Records and Property Leads views works correctly
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data: 3 property leads (1600 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, 38548 Speedwell Ave, 123 Test Street)
